title: GovCERT.HK alert A26-11-48 covers multiple vulnerabilities in Microsoft Edge
date_note: The alert page gives 23 November 2026 as its date; no earlier day is stated.
summary: GovCERT.HK security alert A26-11-48 lists multiple vulnerabilities in Microsoft Edge prior to version 158.0.4370.33. It says a remote attacker could entice a user to open a web page with specially crafted content, and that exploitation could lead to remote code execution, denial of service, elevation of privilege, information disclosure, security restriction bypass, spoofing or tampering. The alert does not say whether any are exploited.
plain: Hong Kong's government CERT says several flaws in Microsoft Edge before version 158.0.4370.33 could let an attacker run code if a user opens a crafted web page. It advises updating Edge.
exec: GovCERT.HK lists multiple Edge flaws in versions prior to 158.0.4370.33; the alert says nothing about exploitation.
action: GovCERT.HK advises users to update Microsoft Edge to version 158.0.4370.33 or later.

evidence.quote: update Microsoft Edge to version 158.0.4370.33 or later to address the issue.

validation.note: Primary: GovCERT.HK, a government CERT, alert read directly.
